preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of operations m must be between 1 and 200,000.
The length of the string s must be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r, c in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation must have valid positions l and r within the bounds of the string.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, str) and len(c) == 1 for l, r, c in operations)
preconditions.description: Each character c in the operations must be a single valid character.

postconditions.description: The output must be the string s after all operations have been performed.
The length of the output string must not exceed the original length n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' if all(c not in s for l, r, c in operations) else True
postconditions.description: If all characters specified in operations are removed, the output must be an empty string.
